QueryReportGenCheck.value: '--Ver1.0 Initial  DECLARE @StartDate datetime =  ? DECLARE @WaitUntil int= ?  DECLARE @i INT = 1; DECLARE @Status NVARCHAR(4) DECLARE @Msg NVARCHAR(260); WAITFOR DELAY '00:01:00'; WHILE (@i <= @WaitUntil*6) BEGIN 	WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:10'; 	SELECT @Status = LEFT([LastStatus], 4) 	FROM ReportServer.[dbo].[Subscriptions] 	INNER JOIN ReportServer.dbo.[Catalog] WITH (NOLOCK) ON Report_OID = ItemID 	WHERE LastRunTime > @StartDate 	SET @Status = ISNULL(@Status, 'NoRn') 	IF (@Status != 'Pend') 	BEGIN 		BREAK 	END 	SET @i = @i + 1; END IF @Status != 'Done' BEGIN 	SET @Msg = FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + '|Error in Report subscription:' + @Status 	RAISERROR (@Msg, 16, 1); END  '

(ISNULL(ds_address_po, '') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ISNULL(ds_city_po, '') + ',' + ISNULL(ds_provstate, '') + '-' + ISNULL(ds_postcode_po, '') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ISNULL('Tel:' + ds_phone_po, '') + isnull(' Fax:' + ds_fax_po, '')) 			FROM division_master dm WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE dm.ds_division = oso.ds_division 			) AS VARCHAR(1000)) 	,[CustomerAddress] = CAST(( 			SELECT (ds_name + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ds_address + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ds_city + ',' + ds_provstate + ' ' + ds_postcode) 			FROM customer_master cm WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE ds_code = ds_customer 			) AS VARCHAR(1000)) 	,CustomerShiptoAddress = CAST(( 			SELECT (ds_name + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ds_address + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ds_city + ',' + ds_provstate + ' ' + ds_postcode + isnull(CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'Tel:' + csh.ds_phone, '')) --+ ' Contact:'+ds_contact) 			FROM customer_shipto csh WITH (NOLOCK) 			WHERE csh.di_customer_shipto_id = fi.di_customer_shipto_id 			) AS VARCHAR(1000)) 	,AccountNumber = fi.ds_customer 	,QuoteNumber = di_sales_order_id_quote 	,Terms = ( 		SELECT ds_name 		FROM dbo.terms t WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE t.di_terms_id = oso.di_terms_id 		) 	,PurchaseOrderNumber =  CAST( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(oso.ds_customer_po_number,CHAR(10),''),CHAR(13),''),CHAR(9),'') as varchar(20)) 	,CustomerJobNumber = ds_customer_job_number 	,ShippedVia = ( 		SELECT Ds_name 		FROM dbo.delivery DL WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE DL.ds_delivery = OSO.ds_delivery 		) 	,SalesPerson = ( 		SELECT ds_name 		FROM dbo.[userstats] WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE ds_usercode = ISNULL(ds_outside_sales, ds_inside_sales) 		) 	,Contact = ( 		SELECT ISNULL(c.ds_name, u.ds_name) 		FROM dbo.[userstats] u WITH (NOLOCK) 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[contact] c WITH (NOLOCK) 			ON u.di_contact_id = c.di_contact_id 		WHERE ds_usercode = ds_inside_sales 		) 	,OrderName = ( 		SELECT ds_name 		FROM dbo.projectname p WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE p.ds_project = oso.ds_project AND p.ds_trans_type = oso.ds_trans_type 		) 	,InvoiceNote = ( 		SELECT (CASE WHEN ds_note = '' THEN NULL ELSE ds_note END) 		FROM note n WITH (NOLOCK) 		WHERE n.di_note_id = fi.di_note_id 		) 	,Invoiced = PRDDTL.di_qty_invoiced 	,Shipped = PRDDTL.di_qty_shipped 	,ProdDesc = PRDDTL.ds_description 	,ProdLineNumber = PRDDTL.di_line_number 	,ProdDetailId = PRDDTL.di_sales_order_dtl_id 	,ChangeOrder = di_Order 	,MiscDescription = ds_misc_desc 	,InvoiceNumber = fi.ds_project 	,ProjectNumber = oso.ds_project 	,InvoiceDate = Convert(VARCHAR(12), dd_invoice, 107) 	,InvoiceDatetime = dd_invoice 	,PreTaxTotal = dn_pretax_total 	,TaxTotal = fi.dn_tax_total 	,IsProd = SUM(ISNULL(Prod, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY fi.di_invoice_id) 	,IsMisc = SUM(ISNULL(Misc, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY fi.di_invoice_id) 	,[InvoiceCreatedDate] =  FI.dd_created   	,[AmountDue] = CAST([dn_pretax_total] + fi.[dn_tax_total] - ISNULL([CustomerPayment], 0) as decimal(14,4)) 	,InvoicedAmount = CAST([dn_pretax_total] + fi.[dn_tax_total] as decimal(14,4)) 	,[CustomerPayment] =CAST([CustomerPayment] as decimal(14,4)) FROM dbo.fin_invoice FI WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.ord_sales_order OSO WITH (NOLOCK) 	ON OSO.di_sales_order_id = FI.di_sales_order_id LEFT JOIN ( 	SELECT di_invoice_id 		,ds_description = ds_description COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT 		,di_line_number 		,fisod.di_sales_order_dtl_id 		,di_qty_invoiced = SUM(di_qty) 		,di_qty_shipped = SUM(di_qty - di_qty_stored) 		,di_Order = NULL 		,ds_misc_desc = NULL 		,Prod = 1 		,Misc = 0 	FROM fin_invoice_sales_order_dtl fisod WITH (NOLOCK) 	INNER JOIN dbo.ord_sales_order_dtl osod WITH (NOLOCK) 		ON osod.di_sales_order_dtl_id = fisod.di_sales_order_dtl_id 	INNER JOIN fin_invoice_sales_order_dtl_opening fisodo WITH (NOLOCK) 		ON fisodo.di_invoice_sales_order_dtl_id = fisod.di_invoice_sales_order_dtl_id 	--WHERE di_invoice_id IN (737244, 775884, 882022, 917474, 922396) 	GROUP BY di_invoice_id 		,ds_description 		,di_line_number 		, fisod.di_sales_order_dtl_id  	UNION ALL 	 	SELECT di_invoice_id 		,ds_description = NULL 		,di_line_number = -1 		,fimc.di_sales_order_miscellaneous_cost_id 		,di_qty_invoiced = NULL 		,di_qty_shipped = NULL 		,di_Order = (CASE WHEN di_order = 0 THEN NULL ELSE di_order END) 		,ds_misc_desc = ds_note COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT 		,Prod = 0 		,Misc = 1 	FROM DBO.fin_invoice_miscellaneous_cost FIMC WITH (NOLOCK) 	INNER JOIN dbo.ord_sales_order_miscellaneous_cost OSOMC WITH (NOLOCK) 		ON OSOMC.di_sales_order_miscellaneous_cost_id = FIMC.di_sales_order_miscellaneous_cost_id 	INNER JOIN dbo.note N 		ON N.di_note_id = OSOMC.di_note_id 			--WHERE di_invoice_id IN (737244, 775884, 882022, 917474, 922396) 	) PRDDTL 	ON FI.di_invoice_id = PRDDTL.di_invoice_id 	LEFT JOIN ( 	SELECT di_invoice_id 		,[CustomerPayment] = SUM(ISNULL(dn_deposit_applied + dn_discount + dn_payment + dn_writeoff, 0)) 	FROM [dbo].[fin_customer_payment_dtl_invoice] ficpdi WITH (NOLOCK) 	INNER JOIN [dbo].[fin_customer_payment_dtl] ficpd WITH (NOLOCK) ON ficpd.di_customer_payment_dtl_id = ficpdi.di_customer_payment_dtl_id 	GROUP BY di_invoice_id 	) ficpd ON ficpd.di_invoice_id = fi.di_invoice_id'

CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IDX_EcomInvoiceDetail_CL] ON [Stg].[EcomInvoiceDetail]
(
	[InvoiceSK] ASC,
	[ProdDetailId] ASC,
	[ProdLineNumber] ASC,
	[SourceSystemId] ASC
)WITH (PAD_INDEX = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, SORT_IN_TEMPDB = OFF,
IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, DROP_EXISTING = OFF, ONLINE = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON, 
ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON) ON [parsch_SourceSystemId_new] ([SourceSystemId])

BEGIN
	DECLARE @CutOffDate date = @EcomFirstRunDate; 
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		 [InvoiceSK]
		,[CustomerNumber] =  CAST('001'+CAST(SourceSystemid as varchar(3)) +'-'+ AccountNumber as varchar(50))
		,[InvoiceDate] = CAST([InvoiceDate] AS date)
		,[PurchaseOrderNumber] = REPLACE([PurchaseOrderNumber],'"','')
		,[InvoiceCreatedDate] = CAST([InvoiceCreatedDate] AS date)
		,[InvoicedAmount]
		,[CustomerPayment]
		,[AmountDue]
		,[PDFFileName] = cast('Div_' + DivisionCode + '_Invoice_'+InvoiceSK+
					 (CASE WHEN [InvoiceCreatedDate] > @CutOffDate THEN '' ELSE '_CTCH' END) as varchar(128))
		,[SourceSystemId]
		,[IsProcessed] = 'N'
		,[ETLCreateDate]
		,[ETLExecutionId]
	INTO #EcomInvProcHist
	FROM Stg.EcomInvoiceDetail I
	WHERE AmountDue <> 0
	AND NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [Stg].[EcomInvProcHist] H WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE I.[InvoiceSK] = H.[InvoiceSK]
		AND  I.AmountDue = H.AmountDue
 	)
 
	DELETE H
	FROM [Stg].[EcomInvProcHist] H
	WHERE EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #EcomInvProcHist T
		WHERE T.InvoiceSK = H.InvoiceSK
		)


	UPDATE H
	SET H.[AmountDue] = 0
	,ETLExecutionId = 0-ETLExecutionId
	FROM [Stg].[EcomInvProcHist] H
	WHERE EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM  Stg.EcomInvoiceDetail T
		WHERE T.InvoiceSK = H.InvoiceSK
		AND T.AmountDue = 0
		)
	AND  H.[AmountDue] <> 0


	--TRUNCATE TABLE [Stg].[EcomInvProcHist]
	INSERT INTO [Stg].[EcomInvProcHist] (
		 [InvoiceSK]
		,[CustomerNumber]
		,[InvoiceDate]
		,[PurchaseOrderNumber]
		,[InvoiceCreatedDate]
		,[InvoicedAmount]
		,[CustomerPayment]
		,[AmountDue]
		,[PDFFileName]
		,[SourceSystemId]
		,[IsProcessed]
		,[ETLCreateDate]
		,[ETLExecutionId]
	)
	SELECT
		  [InvoiceSK]
		,[CustomerNumber]
		,[InvoiceDate]
		,[PurchaseOrderNumber]
		,[InvoiceCreatedDate]
		,[InvoicedAmount]
		,[CustomerPayment]
		,[AmountDue]
		,[PDFFileName]
		,[SourceSystemId]
		,[IsProcessed]
		,[ETLCreateDate]
		,[ETLExecutionId]
	FROM #EcomInvProcHist;
END
